Stage: EXTRACT. Return only the requested strict structure. Select source evidence only by exact source_id and inclusive start/end lines; the host materializes quote text, so never add a quote field. Treat all host identity, usage, and hashes as host-owned facts. Do not expose or request host paths, review configuration, or evaluation material.

staged-scenario-inference-prompts/v0.2
Stage: QUERY. Return only the requested strict structure. Select source evidence only by exact source_id and inclusive start/end lines; the host materializes quote text, so never add a quote field. Treat all host identity, usage, and hashes as host-owned facts. Do not expose or request host paths, review configuration, or evaluation material. You may finish with zero queries when the visible task already resolves the candidates. Otherwise request exactly one query using query_attempt with exactly question, scenario_id, tool, and arguments_json. The compatible inspect_source read form is {source_id:string,start_line:integer,end_line:integer}; inspect_program_structure {source_id:string,symbol?:string}; inspect_dependency_usage {source_id:string,symbol?:string}. Analysis accepts discovered IDs or paths; symbol is an exact syntax name, not target resolution. Read source lines before citing them. arguments_json must encode the named argument object. After a receipt, previous_receipt_assessment must identify that attempt and classify its candidate impact as supports, weakens, or no_new_information; errors and incomplete results still require an assessment. On finish_queries provide stop_explanation with reason evidence_sufficient, unknowns_nonblocking, or no_further_evidence; a concrete rationale, exact source references in evidence, and remaining_unknowns with question, impact, and blocking. Preserve unknowns rather than treating failed exploration as proof. inspect_source is limited to the supplied source IDs and visible ranges.

Stage: CONSTRUCT. Return only the requested strict structure. Select source evidence only by exact source_id and inclusive start/end lines; the host materializes quote text, so never add a quote field. Treat all host identity, usage, and hashes as host-owned facts. Do not expose or request host paths, review configuration, or evaluation material. Preserve test_objectives as only the original visible goals; place newly inferred checks in verification_candidates. Every dependency constraint must state its condition, target call, parameter relationship, allowed return or exception, and relevant state effect. Require exact values, counts, or order only when cited evidence supports them. Describe supported same-scenario variations, or explicitly say none were identified without claiming uniqueness. Keep expected_interactions assertion_policy as not_implied. A test name or an implementation branch alone does not make an interaction required. For every claim_basis and critical_behavior, classify semantic_role as dependency_contract, mut_path_condition, or test_objective, and state whether support is evidence or assumption. Evidence support requires formal evidence IDs; assumption support requires an explicit reason and no evidence IDs. Each critical behavior must point by zero-based formal_claim_index to the matching dependency constraint, scenario hypothesis, or test objective for its role. Map every remaining blocking and nonblocking unknown through claim_basis target unresolved or nonblocking_unknown and its zero-based index.

Select source evidence only by exact source_id and inclusive start/end lines; the host materializes quote text, so never add a quote field. For proposed, identify an alternative Mock plan, the supported behavior it bypasses, evidence IDs, and the smallest distinguishing observation. Use none_identified only after completing the attempt without an evidence-backed alternative. An AMBIGUOUS result may be contrasted without selecting either candidate. Request semantic revision only when the contrast establishes that a legal same-scenario alternative should replace or change the formal candidates. Mark the contrast as evidence-supported with evidence_ids, or as an explicit assumption with an assumption_reason and no evidence IDs. It remains a static prediction with execution_status not_executed. Classify its semantic_role using the same three-way distinction.
